detail.title: Synthesis of Quantum Objectivity and Record Robustness
detail.summary: This update synthesizes current research on objective record formation, robustness, and the impact of quantum scrambling. We define objective records as those redundantly encoded in environmental states, enabling observer consensus. We also revise notebooks to account for the competitive role of scrambling, which delocalizes information and challenges the persistence of local, observable records. Limitations regarding system size and experimental validation persist across all domains.
